cards.headline: AI Model Restrictions: Anthropic Limits Claude Code Subscriptions
cards.blurb: Anthropic is no longer allowing Claude Code subscriptions to use OpenClaw due to a privilege escalation vulnerability. This change affects users who rely on OpenClaw for their AI models. The vulnerability was recently discovered and reported.
cards.why_it_matters: This restriction highlights the importance of security in AI development, as vulnerabilities can have significant consequences for users and organizations. It also underscores the need for ongoing monitoring and updates in the rapidly evolving AI landscape.

sources.title: Tell HN: Anthropic no longer allowing Claude Code subscriptions to use OpenClaw

cards.headline: Event-Based Stereo Networks Advance with EventHub
cards.blurb: EventHub is a new data factory for generalizable event-based stereo networks that doesn't require active sensors. This innovation enables more efficient and flexible event-based stereo vision. EventHub's approach can be applied to various applications, including robotics and autonomous vehicles.
cards.why_it_matters: The development of EventHub has implications for the advancement of autonomous vehicles and robotics, where event-based stereo vision can improve navigation and perception capabilities. This technology can also reduce the complexity and cost of traditional stereo vision systems.

sources.title: EventHub: Data Factory for Generalizable Event-Based Stereo Networks without Active Sensors

cards.headline: Generative Video Games: ActionParty Introduces Multi-Subject Action Binding
cards.blurb: ActionParty is a new approach to generative video games that enables multi-subject action binding. This allows for more dynamic and interactive game experiences. ActionParty's technology can be used to create a wide range of games and simulations.
cards.why_it_matters: The introduction of ActionParty has the potential to revolutionize the gaming industry by enabling more immersive and engaging experiences. This technology can also be applied to other fields, such as education and training, where interactive simulations can enhance learning outcomes.

cards.headline: Space Exploration: Artemis II Crew Captures Stunning Image of Earth
cards.blurb: The Artemis II crew has taken a 'spectacular' image of Earth from space. This image was captured during the crew's mission to test the Orion spacecraft and its systems. The image provides a unique perspective on our planet and its place in the universe.
cards.why_it_matters: The success of the Artemis II mission has significant implications for future space exploration, including the potential for manned missions to the Moon and beyond. The images and data captured during this mission can also contribute to our understanding of the Earth and its systems.

cards.headline: Secondary Eclipse Photometry: New Insights from JWST/MIRI
cards.blurb: A new study using JWST/MIRI has provided insights into the secondary eclipse photometry of GJ 3473 b. The study used data from the Hot Rocks Survey to analyze the exoplanet's properties. The results of the study contribute to our understanding of exoplanetary systems and their formation.
cards.why_it_matters: The study of exoplanetary systems has significant implications for our understanding of the universe and its many mysteries. The use of advanced telescopes and instruments, such as JWST/MIRI, can provide new insights into the properties and behavior of exoplanets, and shed light on the formation and evolution of planetary systems.

sources.title: Hot Rocks Survey V: Secondary Eclipse Photometry of GJ 3473 b with JWST/MIRI

cards.headline: Drone Regulations: FAA Restricts Filming of ICE Activities
cards.blurb: The FAA has introduced a flight restriction for drones that aims to prevent the filming of ICE activities. The restriction has been criticized for attempting to criminalize the use of drones for journalism and activism. The restriction applies to certain areas and activities, and drone operators must comply with the new rules.
cards.why_it_matters: The introduction of this restriction has significant implications for the use of drones in journalism and activism, and raises concerns about freedom of speech and the right to document public activities. The restriction can also have implications for the development of drone technology and its applications in various fields.
